lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the Ecology Commission taking up a proposed ordinance that would ban gas-powered leaf blowers in Telluride by 2028 and all combustion lawn equipment by 2030 — a real policy change worth paying attention to if you have opinions about it. The county commissioners also have a special budget session Wednesday with actual dollar decisions on the table, including a $50,000 Chamber seed-money request and wildfire mitigation funding. The Housing Authority subcommittee weighs in on a $160,000 deed-restricted roof replacement that tests the limits of capital improvement rules.
